name: 31336-specbench-8b-1gpu-eagle3logprobs
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, bf16, 8.19B params: 36 layers, hidden 4096, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, vocab 151936, 16.4 GB of weights; the EAGLE-3 draft head adds 2.0 GB bf16.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, bound 256 requests, warmup 15%, safety_seconds 1800.
workload: Spec-Bench first-turn prompts across six domains -- chat, translation, summarization, QA, math reasoning and RAG. `configs/data/specbench-seed0-first256.jsonl`: 256 requests, 283 prompt tokens mean (min 17, max 1490), 512 output tokens requested per request with EOS honoured, greedy (temperature 0.0), logprobs=2 on every request.
purpose: A general-purpose 8B assistant with a draft model, serving 32 concurrent users mixed short prompts with token probabilities on one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B

# State `num_speculative_tokens`: the draft checkpoint's own proposal method declares 3, so
# leaving it out silently drafts a different K.
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle3", "model": "RedHatAI/Qwen3-8B-speculator.eagle3", "num_speculative_tokens": 2}

# State this explicitly: at this engine `async_scheduling` left unset resolves to False whenever a
# `speculative_config` is present, so an unstated value serves a different configuration.
async-scheduling: true

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
